items.title: What is coding?
items.response: Coding is a way of writing instructions so that a computer can do something, like play a game or draw a picture. It is like giving a recipe to the computer.

items.title: What is internet safety?
items.response: Internet safety means using the internet in a way that keeps you and your information protected. It means not talking to strangers, keeping passwords secret, and asking a grown-up for help.
